name: inkpad
description: Handwriting notes app for Android tablets, iPads and the browser

scripts.android:sync: node scripts/build-web.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: node scripts/build-web.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sync: node scripts/build-web.js && npx cap sync ios
